newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo to invest $500 mln in Latam.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo to invest $500 mln in Latam.

text.p: Daewoo Electronics, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Thursday it plans to invest $500 million in Latin America by the year 2000.

Daewoo Electronics plans to build electronic home appliance complexes in Brazil to annually produce 500,000 colour television sets and 200,000 units each of video cassette recorders (VCR), refrigerators, and washing machines. The plants are expected to be completed by 1997.
In Mexico, the company also plans to start production of 600,000 micro-wave ovens from 1998 and two million colour television tubes annually from the end of 1997.
A Daewoo statement said the company already expanded television production lines early this year and launched VCR and monitor production lines in Mexico.

Under the mid- and long-term strategy, Daewoo plans to expand annual production capacity of refrigerators and washing machines in Mexico to 400,000 and 300,000 units respectively in the future, the statement said.
Daewoo would expand the number of sales agents in Latin America from the current eight in order to secure a 20 percent market share in the region, valued at about $2 billion.
